notes.title: Patch note 1.3
notes.content:
Below are the fixes and additions in patch 1.3:

Added Hard Mode and its related achievement

Added Easter eggs and related achievements

Added Old Game mode

Fixed issues on monitors with non-16:9 aspect ratios

Minor fixes to hitboxes, menus, and more

notes.title: Redrop Speedrun Showdown - Win Game Keys!
notes.content:
Do you have what it takes to beat Redrop fast?

Join our official Next Fest Speedrun Contest running until June 16th! Submit your best demo speedrun time - top 10 players win a full game key, and the top 3 get extra keys to share:

🥇 1st Place: 3 game keys
🥈 2nd Place: 2 game keys
🥉 3rd Place: 2 game keys
🏅 4th–10th: 1 key each

To be eligible, you must provide a video (clip, stream, recording or video youtube) showing your full run and the final in-game timer. No audio required.

You can submit your runs as many times as you want, and if you improve your time, feel free to send us your new best video.



Submit your entry by:

Posting a link or screenshot in the Steam Community

Or emailing: redropgame@gmail.com

⏳ Deadline: June 16th
🏆 Winners announced: June 17th



*More participants may unlock more winners or keys!

notes.title: 📢Controls Info for Redroppers
notes.content:
Hey ReDroppers! Having fun (aka suffering)?

Just a quick note about the controls in Redrop.

The game currently shows only the base controls, and there is no control remapping feature at the moment. However, there are many additional buttons that work, both on keyboard and controller, even if they're not shown on screen!

Here’s a list of extra keyboard controls you can use:

🎮 Movement
A / D
Left / Right Arrow
Numpad 4 / Numpad 6



🔄 Redrop (Restart)
R
Page Down
T
Right Mouse Button



🦘 Jump
Spacebar
Up Arrow
Down Arrow
Numpad 8



⏸ Pause
Escape



✅ Confirm / Interact
E
Enter
Left Mouse Button



🏃 Run
Left Shift
Right Shift



We will not show controller being pretty straight forward.



💬 We want your feedback!
If you have ideas for alternative buttons that would make the game more comfortable for you, feel free to comment on this post or email us at 

redropgame@gmail.com

we’d love to add more options based on what works best for players!

Thanks for playing!
